actual.claim: At 13:24 on 14 October 2024, the R3 delivery carrier beam fell into the mill pit and struck the sled and scaffold platform. The assembly was raised after backup-roll removal. No person was struck. The keeper plate was found bolted to the recovered assembly; the beam and yoke were not reported fractured.
